label: positive

blockers.detail: harness never calls pcre2_set_compile_extra_options(); extra options are always 0, so (xoptions & PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT) is constant false

evidence: HEAD audit (2026-10): src/pcre2_fuzzsupport.c still never sets compile extra options
rationale_zh: 本次提交新增编译期 extra 选项 PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT：开启后，模式中的 (?C...) 会被拒绝（ERR103）。该选项只能通过 pcre2_set_compile_extra_options() 设置，模式文本无法开启。harness 创建了 compile_context，却从不设置 extra 选项，xoptions 恒为 0，新分支在 harness 下永远不可达。harness 照常编译运行，只是静默丢失这段新代码的覆盖，属于本次引入的隐式 api 退化。反事实修复：用输入中未使用的随机位驱动 extra 选项（≤15 行，只改 harness）。
rationale_en: This commit adds the compile-time extra option PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT, which rejects (?C...) callouts with ERR103. The option can only be set via pcre2_set_compile_extra_options(); no pattern syntax enables it. The harness creates a compile context but never sets extra options, so xoptions is always 0 and the new branch is unreachable. The harness builds and runs normally and silently loses coverage of the new code: silent api degradation introduced by this change. Counterfactual fix: drive the extra options from unused random bits of the input (≤15 lines, harness only).
